history.summary: A 2016 freehold 3BR in D23 (Hillview/Bukit Panjang) at $1.528M / $1595 PSF — slightly below the project URA median of $1645 — in the liquid sub-$1.6M band. The resale-only appreciation of 3.7%/yr on 26 transactions is honest but unremarkable OCR-fringe growth, and the listing carries no MRT proximity, a known D23 Hillview weakness.
history.rating_rationale: Positives: freehold, $1595 PSF is ~3% under the project median ($1645), liquid price band, resale-only 3.7%/yr with no new-launch bias on a reasonable 26 txns, and a solid 594/1000 score. But D23 Hillview is an OCR-fringe location with no MRT distance listed (Hillview MRT/DTL is the realistic option but not at the doorstep), and 3.7%/yr is below RCR alternatives. A fair, fully-priced freehold hold rather than a standout buy.
red_flags: No MRT proximity listed — D23 Hillview is car-dependent for many blocks
D23 sits below RCR districts on the demand/appreciation curve
catalysts: Priced slightly under project URA median PSF
Hillview/Rail Corridor amenity and DTL Hillview MRT in the wider area
